author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX is preparing for what could be the most important Starship flight yet! Flight 15 is approaching, and SpaceX is planning to attempt something never done before: catching BOTH Super Heavy Booster 22 and Starship Ship 42 back at Starbase!

With both vehicles having completed their static fire campaigns, attention is turning to final preparations, FAA approvals, and a potential November 12 launch date. Flight 15 could also see Ship 42 spend roughly 24 hours in orbit before returning to Starbase for its historic catch attempt.

Meanwhile, Flight 16 is taking shape! Booster 23 and Ship 43 have completed cryogenic testing, with preparations continuing for what could become Starship's first launch from Florida's Kennedy Space Center at Launch Complex 39A.

In this week's Starship Update, we're covering all the latest developments across SpaceX's Starship program, including:

🚀 Flight 15: Booster 22 and Ship 42 prepare for a potential historic double catch, with a possible 24-hour orbit
title: The Catch That Will Unlock SpaceX's Future | Starship Update
